task: redteam: subdomain-takeover-check analyze.mjs + ucr-fee-calculator calc.mjs campaigns; hunt real bugs in the takeover checker

errors.what: A PreToolUse hook blocked a command that both started http.server and ran pkill on it; the heredoc in the same command never ran

doc_friction.issue: Step 0 says fix every open entry first, but all 8 open entries were control-plane workflow edits already open as owner-gated PRs; redteam.py open could print the open PR next to each entry so a run does not have to search for it.

deviations.why: Step 0: every open defect is a control-plane edit already open as a PR waiting for owner approval (#14877, #14808, #14612, #14698, #15201, #15248, #12928, #12926); opening another duplicate would add to the P061/P063 pile.
deviations.did: Left patched:false and went straight to seeding and hunting.
deviations.result: Found and fixed one new real defect instead.

notes: Campaigns: analyze.mjs 10 seeded, 8 caught, 1 equivalent (unreachable ?? fallback in matchedHop), 1 gap (clean:true on the unconfirmed verdict; index.html colours from clean). calc.mjs 8/8. Real defect: pasted URL -> DoH NXDOMAIN -> no-cname -> clean, exit 0. Reproduced against cloudflare-dns.com with curl (Status 3 for name https://www.github.com/). Fixed with parseHostname in analyze.mjs, used by check.mjs runCheck and index.html; failing tests first in check.test.mjs. Page checked in Chromium: non-hostname input shows a refusal, no page errors. Suite: run_venture_tests.py subdomain-takeover-check ok (105 tests). Sibling check: email-auth-check already strips scheme/path (normalizeDomainArg); caa-record-check and dns-configuration-evidence not audited this run.

real_defects.issue: A pasted URL (https://host/path) or any non-hostname was sent to the DoH resolver as-is; Cloudflare answers NXDOMAIN, which classify reads as no-cname, so the CLI and page reported No subdomain-takeover risk found (exit 0) even for a dangling CNAME. Fixed with parseHostname() in analyze.mjs used by check.mjs and index.html; tests in check.test.mjs.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
